description: Set the company's cancellation policy, company owners only: a guest who cancels at least `cancel_refund_days` before the charter gets `cancel_refund_percent` of the charter price back. The policy applies to the company's MMK and Nausys bookings only; its direct boats follow charter.boats terms, so a company whose boats are all direct is refused. Read get_cancellation_limits first. Returns the company as it now stands.

cancel_refund_days.description: Days before the charter the guest must cancel by, 1 to 90.

cancel_refund_percent.description: Share of the charter price refunded, 0 to 100.

company_id.description: Company id, from list_boats (`company_id`) or get_company.

name: set_cancellation_policy
